items.description: Western Europe has recorded its hottest-ever June and July, and extreme weather from wildfires to storms is here to stay. How can we adapt to what seems to be the new normal? Cities like Kiel are trying new ideas.

items.title: Lebanon parliament votes to abolish death penalty
items.description: The new law - which next goes to the cabinet for approval - would make Lebanon the first country in the Middle East to end capital punishment.

items.title: Can the new PKK law bring peace to Turkey?
items.description: Turkey’s parliament has passed a framework law for the peace process with the Kurdistan Workers’ Party (PKK). What does it stipulate, why is it controversial and what does it mean for the future of the peace process?

items.title: Hungary's parliament elects Orban critic as new president
items.description: Hungary's parliament has overwhelmingly confirmed Andras Baka, formerly the head of the Supreme Court, to the largely ceremonial role of president. New Prime Minister Peter Magyar controversially removed his predecessor.

items.title: New Zealand PM survives second leadership challenge ahead of election
items.description: Christopher Luxon says he has "full support" of his party, after a vote of confidence 12 weeks before a general election.

items.title: Key issues in Zambia's 2026 general election
items.description: Economic recovery, youth turnout, women's representation and judicial independence are among the issues shaping Zambia's vote on Thursday.
